propositions: Pure evidence-prepack single-pass verifier produces false-positive rejections when the prepack is incomplete; a filter-only (PASS/ABSTAIN) stage followed by narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejection by construction.
Filter coverage is bimodal by AC style: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) achieve ~90% PASS rate; ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side effects rationally ABSTAIN.
Filter+fallback design reduces token cost by 26% overall (-46% on real all-met tickets) with zero false PASSes on adversarial unmet ACs and negligible filter cost (~0.4% of agentic spend).
Agentic verifier itself exhibits low-rate false-FAILs on genuinely-met ACs (observed on identical criteria sets); filter design narrows but does not remove this residual risk.
Description-block reduction via monkeypatched show_ticket seam automatically narrows agentic step budget and works cleanly including epic child traversal.

Productization requires filter citations recorded in verdict for auditability, coverage telemetry per AC style to gate filter calls, and re-validation of 8000-char description cap after AC-block reduction.
